# InDesign Feature Use Cards

These cards convert the source-backed leaf inventory into implementation-planning records for Handshake Studio. They are intentionally marked `toc_inferred`: the source inventory proves that the feature topic exists, while the detailed Studio behavior still needs promotion through command contracts, implementation, and the internal Studio UserManual gate.

```yaml
coverage_basis: "Adobe InDesign desktop help leaf index, feature_leaf records only."
feature_use_card_count: 542
explanation_status: "toc_inferred_from_verified_help_inventory"
manual_entry_status: "planning_only_until_implemented"
implementation_readiness: "needs_command_contract_promotion"
source_page_inspection: "not_inspected_per_card"
```

</topic>
